Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a web site for information on fugitives.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a web site for information on fugitives; addinga new section to chapter 72.09 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that some offenders,often known as escapees or fugitives, willfully discontinue to makethemselves available to the department of corrections for supervisionby making their whereabouts unknown or by failing to maintain contactwith the department as required by their community custody officers.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of corrections shall disseminate to the public alist of all persons deemed escapees or fugitives from the departmentthrough the department's available web site. On the web site, thedepartment shall post the name, photograph, and a brief description ofeach unapprehended convicted felon who has escaped the department'scommunity supervision. The web site must also include a contact phone p. 1 HB 2661number for citizens with information leading to the whereabouts of suchindividuals.
